horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Kanifaido y los peligros del deseo. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P28 — Kanifaido. Kanifaido: solid young adult man, broad rounded face, wider mouth and nose, straight blunt SHORT black hair. LOW short emerald/charcoal feather ring, a sparse red/black seed choker with four curved cream PAPER pendants, cream knee-length fibre wrap with BIG FRONT charcoal double chevron and red uneven lower edge. ONE small pale nose quill and separate white-paper upper-arm strips. Emerald/red identity, no violent trophy or sexual anatomy. Fragile repaired state removes heavy crown.
Reference 2: L08-52 — Casa hostil de Kanifaido. 
Reference 3: A12-avispa — Avispas · cuidanderos. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide low-sun forest threshold. ONE whole Kanifaido matching P28, sturdy adult with emerald/charcoal short feather ring, small pale nose quill and red-edged cream knee fibre wrap, approaches ONE closed raw-timber palm-thatched hostile house like L08-52. Its entrance is blocked by a dense raised PAPER arc of whole small wasps like A12-avispa, insects anatomically legible with six legs and paired wings. He hesitates one step before them, no attack or injury. One impossible threshold relation: insects become a continuous moving barrier with an inviting empty gap that immediately closes. No seductive woman portrait, body consumption, modern cabin or decorative wasp crown.

VISIBLE CHECK: Kanifaido entero ante casa cerrada y barrera de avispas.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 25 percent and recenter ALL THREE adults: the whole kneeling father at left, whole repaired seated Kanifaido in the middle and whole woman at the doorway. Reveal the father left shoulder, left arm, kneeling legs and feet fully inside the vertical frame. Preserve the gentle hand touching the repaired shoulder, every identity, nasal quill, clothes, layered paper repair, woman reaching and maloca interior. No injury, no blood and no new people.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

Reference 1: V17 — Kanifaido: restos y reparación. 
Reference 2: B13 — Cumare / chambira · fibra. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE complete narrow-fibre HUMAN-SHAPED PAPER WEAVE is the single carrier, abstract and modest, not a realistic nude person, skeleton or corpse. A central cream fibre thread is pulled one step too early and the woven chest opens into a neat unravelling gap, while the whole outline remains visible. Original editorial metaphor for unfinished restoration losing its coherence. Warm ochre weave and muted red tie against quiet charcoal-green layers; the vulnerable connected thread and small opening are readable at thumbnail. No literal hands, woman, monster, medicine, blood or diagram.

VISIBLE CHECK: Silueta tejida completa que comienza a deshacerse al tirar de su hilo central.
